body:
Tested ground friction: tightens lateral spread (~0.6-0.7 -> ~0.3-0.5) but doesn't fix Y-flatness -- real, partial. Reframed the actual goal mid-conversation: lying flat is correct, the real bug is the poker-straight symmetric shape. New RAGDOLL_ORIENTATION_NORTHSTAR.md: swing-axis constraints from rest-pose geometry (no new asset metadata), phased major-joints-first, twist as v1. Also directly answered the founder's own robotics/CAD question (real actuator metadata per SIM-100 SS3, not full CAD) and recovery-realism concern (imitation reward against a reference clip, per SIM-100's own Reward Compiler, not a physics tuning problem). SHANKPIT fe0fc2d.
